subject.title: Feishu: benign non-zero exec exit codes render as "Exec failed" in tool-progress and interrupt streaming; no per-channel toolProgress toggle

question: Should Feishu adopt the shared nested `streaming.preview.toolProgress` and `streaming.preview.commandText` policy, and should `channels.feishu.streaming` remain protected from agent-facing `config.patch`?
rationale: The source-level UX problem is clear, but the durable fix changes Feishu's public config shape and touches a model-to-operator mutation boundary, so automation should not choose that product/security policy alone.

options.title: Adopt shared Feishu preview policy
options.body: Extend Feishu to accept the shared nested preview config while preserving current boolean/default behavior and leave gateway `config.patch` protection unchanged unless separately approved.

options.title: Only soften exec wording
options.body: Keep Feishu boolean-only streaming and adjust failure wording, which is smaller but leaves users without a way to keep streaming while hiding progress lines.

options.title: Allow coarse streaming toggle
options.body: Permit `config.patch` to change `channels.feishu.streaming`, which improves recovery but broadens an operator-controlled path and does not provide status-only progress.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared Feishu preview policy
recommendation.body: Extend Feishu to accept the shared nested preview config while preserving current boolean/default behavior and leave gateway `config.patch` protection unchanged unless separately approved.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced Feishu Card Kit streaming and the boolean config surface that this decision would extend.
